content.title: Restrict slot visibility to chosen Abhyasis
content.intent: Publish a slot chosen for one linked Abhyasi; an unselected linked Abhyasi must not see it while the chosen Abhyasi can.
content.technique_notes: Negative/auth and list-membership exclusion; known unselected linked user is the negative witness. Strength=3 from auth/data-loss; three-way combinations belong to the valid-input sweep, not a license to infer other visibility rules. Under four-pair ceiling highest-risk privacy path.
